name: Yanase Kaori
source:
Fighting Style: Tae Kwon Do.
Birthplace / Origin: Chiba prefecture.
Occupation: 2nd-year student at private junior college "F", part-time waitress (Mohi-kan).
Likes / Loves: Onsen, ice cream.
Dislikes / Hates: Dirty (minded/acting/living) people, raw fish.
Hobbies: Collecting PC correspondence (E-mail), violin.

A 19-year old computer technician schooled in the art of Tae Kwon Do. She initially entered the V.G. tournament to test her own abilities, but found herself humiliated in the final round by [url=/c6820]Reimi Jahana[/url]. Ever since, she has devoted her training to defeating the multi-time V.G. champion. Despite this, Kaori apparently bears no ill will towards her would-be rival and simply sees defeating her as part of the path she must travel to become stronger.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=http://fenixware.net/fab/fab_charMain.asp?id=2293&order=0]Fight-A-Base[/url].]
